rows.grounds: compound of rasa (six) and aśra (corner), qualifying the spire and neck
object denoting the neck section below the spire
compound of kūṭa (peak), koṣṭha (compartment), and ādi (and-so-on)
past participle indicating conjunction with the listed components

items.question: What geometric form and accompanying components must the temple spire and neck possess?
premises: The spire is specified as six-cornered.
The neck is specified as six-cornered.
The spire and neck are joined with peak, compartment, and related elements.
items.inference: The temple spire and neck must be six-cornered and integrated with peak, compartment, and similar components.
uncertainties: The exact scope of ādi in kūṭakoṣṭhādi is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The spire and the neck should be six-cornered and joined with the peak, compartment, and other such parts.
